faq_a1: The basic income and statistics dashboard is free. Paid features and partner perks will appear later
faq_a2: You add a service account, sign in data is encrypted. Statistics mode only reads data and does not manage orders
faq_q3: Where are service access tokens stored?
faq_a3: Integration authorization tokens are used in transit for syncing and are not stored on our server
faq_a4: You are the only one who sees your data, client data is anonymized, we work under 152-FZ
faq_q5: Can I accept orders right in the app?
faq_a5: Yes. In Work mode an order can be accepted right in Raznos, it comes from your service and the payout comes from there too. In Statistics mode Raznos only shows the data
final_h2: See all your delivery income in one place
final_dek: Open the live prototype and walk through the courier scenarios
faq_q6: Is Raznos an employer, who pays?
faq_a6: No. Raznos does not pay for orders and does not hand them out. The employer and payer is the delivery service itself. We connect to your services, show the orders, help accept them and honestly count the income, the money comes from the service
cmp_h2: Pay and service ratings side by side
cmp_dek: Raznos publishes anonymized statistics on services: pay, the number of couriers and orders, penalties, ratings and reviews. Compare and choose where it pays more
faq_a7: There are no direct analogs in Russia. Abroad there are partial analogs:
faq_q8: How do I sign in to the services I work with?
faq_a8: You enter your phone or login and password for your service once, and confirm with an SMS or email code if needed. Sign in data is encrypted and goes straight to the service itself, we never get a copy of your login and password. In Statistics mode access is read only, Raznos pulls your history and income but does not manage the account. Disconnect a service or delete your account and the related data is removed
faq_q9: What do you do with my data?
faq_a9: Only you see your personal dashboard with income and history. Anonymized data goes into the shared statistics by service and city so everyone can see who pays how much, and it cannot be traced back to a specific person. Disconnect a service or delete your account and the related data is removed
faq_q10: Is there a demo mode, can I try it?
faq_a10: Yes. Open the live prototype with the button below and walk through the courier scenarios. It runs on demo data, without connecting real accounts. Connecting your own services will come in the beta
